title: Nonnegative Viscosity and Weak Solutions to Trudinger's Parabolic Equation
summary: We study the relation between viscosity solutions and weak solutions of the equation $$\partial_t\left(|u|^{p-2}u\right)\,=\, \operatorname{div}(|\nabla u|^{p-2}\nabla u).$$ We prove that at least for non-negative functions these are equivalent concepts.
